title: US yields move to multi year highs as the wall of worry is growing.
description: US Treasury yields are trading at highs across the curve. The 10-year yield is above 5.09%, and the 30-year is near 5.39%. The question for traders is whether yields can stay at these levels as the market weighs strong growth against the risk of more inflation. At the time of the yield snapshot: 2-year: 4.8952%. title: US treasury sells $70 billion of 5 year notes at a high yield of 5.033%
description: The Treasury sold $70 billion of five-year notes at a high yield of 5.033%, compared with a when-issued (WI) yield of 5.002% just before the auction. That is a 3.1-basis-point tail, well above the six-auction average of 0.6 basis points.
